name: Turn employee feedback into owned actions
why: Comment themes, owned actions and a reply to staff with small groups kept private, matching steps 4 to 6 of the survey skill.

name: Employee feedback action review assistant
why: Tracks the actions agreed after a survey and drafts the staff update, the monthly step of the survey to action cycle.

name: Survey answer truth checker
why: Checks how far a survey can be trusted before acting on it, a useful test before the read-out.

name: Prepare a survey findings briefing
why: A checked findings table and honest caveats for the owner or board briefing after a staff survey.

name: Recognition plan designer
why: A goal-based recognition scheme to compare with the four-layer recognition programme skill.

name: Key moment designer
why: Plans one memorable team event with owners, dates and costs, for the bigger moments in the team calendar.

name: Write a culture memo your team lives by
why: The full culture memo and daily habits workflow behind the culture memo prompt.

name: Team culture memo writer
why: A one-page culture memo with decision and feedback rules, a quick start for the culture work.

name: Announce a change of direction and keep the team
why: Hard-news messaging for a change of direction, alongside the change announcement prompt.

name: Make a new policy understandable to staff
why: Turns an approved policy into a plain explanation, announcement and rollout list.

name: Review staff adoption of a policy change
why: The 30-day check on whether a change landed, with small groups kept private.

name: New hire onboarding keeper
why: Runs the first 90 days with weekly progress calls, pairing with the onboarding check-in prompt.

name: Review employee data access before a change
why: Checks who can see staff data before a new survey or HR tool goes live.
